AttributeList.Text: NOT YET WIRED INTO Main[OB1] - built and compiles clean, but deliberately not called anywhere yet. Two things need to happen first: (1) confirm real physical %I/%Q addresses for the ET200SP DI/DQ modules - an address probe run 2026-08-08 found every DI/DQ module reporting StartAddress=-1, meaning either they are not actually seated in real rack slots or addresses simply are not assigned until a real download; needs visual confirmation in TIA's Device view before anything here can read real hardware. (2) FB_ValveLoop's own simulated OpenFB/ClosedFB writes (Section 1 "Motion Simulation") need a guard added so they skip any valve that has a real channel assigned here, otherwise the simulation will keep overwriting whatever this mapper writes. Until both are done, every valve stays on symbolic simulation exactly as today - this block is inert scaffolding, safe to have present without affecting the running demo.
